============
Installation
============

System Requirements
===================

* Python 3.8+
* Linux OS
* HPC system with SLURM or PBS

Installation
============

From Source
-----------

.. code-block:: bash

   git clone https://github.com/user/hpc-scaletest.git
   cd hpc-scaletest
   pip install -r requirements.txt

With pip
--------

.. code-block:: bash

   pip install hpc-scaletest

Virtual Environment
-------------------

.. code-block:: bash

   python3 -m venv hpc-env
   source hpc-env/bin/activate
   pip install -r requirements.txt

See :doc:`getting_started` for usage.
